comment: Configuration of bench/leak-scan.mjs, which CI runs on every push and pull request. Every entry needs a reason. Nothing here names a private value: private words are listed by the SHA-256 of their lower-case form (add one with: node bench/leak-scan.mjs --hash <word>).

terms.comment: Words that must never appear as a token anywhere in the repository (host, account, tailnet and keychain names of the lab machines). Matched by hash, case-insensitive, on every token and every part of a token split at '-', '_' and '.'. No allow entry can lift a term hit.

paths.comment: Positive list of repository paths (JavaScript regex). A file that no entry matches fails the scan, so a new kind of file (raw PC output, a private input, a local settings file) is noticed in review before it is published.

jevRows.comment: Jev result rows (results/<family>/jev/*.jsonl) are public since TypeSafe's permission of 2026-10-10. The export keeps only these fields of every row and drops any other one; the leak scan fails on a Jev row with a field outside this list. A new field (request id, header, account, raw response) therefore stays private until someone adds it here on purpose.
